description: Search the game's icon textures by name and return the path and FileDataID for each. Icons follow a naming convention (spell_fire_*, inv_sword_*, ability_warrior_*), so searching by theme works well. Use this to pick an icon for a button, an addon compartment entry, or a .toc IconTexture.

query.description: Icon name fragment, e.g. fireball, sword, warrior.

name: wow_icon_search
title: Find an icon texture
